# =============================================================================
#
# Abstract
# --------
# Exact versions of the CPU build of PyTorch and of its dependencies, as
# served by https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu, for the test, coverage,
# integration and model zoo workflows. Every distribution carries its SHA-256
# hash, and the file names the PyTorch index itself, so
#   python -m pip install --require-hashes -r .github/requirements/requirements-ci-torch.txt
# installs exactly the reviewed files (OpenSSF Scorecard, Pinned-Dependencies).
# One file covers CPython 3.10 to 3.14.
#
# The PyTorch index is not reachable from every environment that runs
# `make lock`, so this file is compiled by the Torch Lock workflow
# (.github/workflows/torch-lock.yml) from requirements-ci-torch.in. Do not
# edit the uv output by hand: run the workflow and copy its output here.
#
# The list below is generated by uv. Each entry shows which requirement pulled
# the package in ("via").
# =============================================================================

# Install every distribution from the PyTorch CPU index.
--index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu
